{{Top|leg}}
The '''Iphigini''' [[Species/Legends|species]] came from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iphigin]], one of the main cargo transfer points for three [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], they offered to help mediate a dispute between their neighbors, the [[Ishori]] and the [[Diamal]]a. They were unable to do so, even with the help of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and the Ishori/Diamala dispute soon became part of the greater [[Caamas Document]] crisis.

Iphigini had craggy faces and melodious voices. Younger Iphigini often wore braided lip-beards.
